cd /workspace && python3 - <<'EOF'
import sys,io
sys.path.insert(0,'deps')
import zstandard as zstd
c=zstd.ZstdCompressor()
d=bytearray(c.compress(b'hello world'))
print('orig',d.hex(),zstd.get_frame_parameters(bytes(d)).content_size)
# flag0x20 single, header6: bytes [0:4] magic [4] flag [5] FCS1
for val in [0,1,5,11,12,100]:
 x=bytearray(d);x[5]=val
 try:
  p=zstd.get_frame_parameters(bytes(x));print('val',val,'param content',p.content_size)
  r=zstd.ZstdDecompressor().stream_reader(io.BytesIO(bytes(x)),read_across_frames=True)
  out=r.read();print('  out',out)
 except Exception as e: print('  ERR',type(e),e)
EOF
